methodologyNotes: Specs sourced from official manufacturer spec pages (Apple Support, Samsung newsroom, Microsoft Learn, OnePlus, Lenovo), Wikipedia, and reputable launch coverage (Android Authority, Tom's Guide, PhoneArena, 9to5Google, Engadget, Windows Central). Numbers are stored unit-free; units implied by key name (display_in = diagonal inches, refresh_hz = Hz, ram_gb = GB, storage_gb = base config GB, battery_mah = mAh, weight_g = grams). battery_mah for Apple products is converted from official Wh at 3.82V nominal (38.99Wh → 10207mAh for iPad Pro M5 13, 36.59Wh → 9579mAh for iPad Air M4 13, 28.93Wh → 7575mAh for iPad 11 A16) — Apple's official pages report Wh only; mAh estimates are flagged in provenance. storage_gb is the lowest announced base config globally; priceUsd is the US launch MSRP for that base config. For Surface Pro 11, the base consumer Snapdragon X Plus model with IPS display at $999 is used as reference. OS is the version at launch. A null beats any guess; priceUsd=null only where no US MSRP exists. accessedAt is 2026-06-15 on every source.
